test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 28 Dec, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: If the length of a rectangle is thrice its breadth and the perimeter of that rectangle is 48 cm, then find its area (in cm²).
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of **Length (L)** to **Breadth (B)** = 3 : 1

Sum of ratio parts for perimeter = 2 × (3 + 1) = 8 units

8 units = 48 cm ⇒ 1 unit (Breadth) = 6 cm & 3 units (Length) = 18 cm

Area = L × B = 18 × 6 = 108 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 108 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** **Perimeter** = 48 cm, **Length (L)** = 3 × **Breadth (B)**

**Formula Used:** Perimeter = 2(L + B) | Area = L × B

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/37dbc6b80e68075eae41026126b2606b60dc60a67e8fbeb8062ef1239738b67b.png] 

⇒ Let Breadth = x, then Length = 3x

⇒ 2(3x + x) = 48

⇒ 2(4x) = 48

⇒ 8x = 48

⇒ x = 6 cm

⇒ Length = 3 × 6 = 18 cm

⇒ Area = 18 × 6 = 108 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 108 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Properties of a Rectangle

A rectangle is a quadrilateral with **opposite sides equal** and all **interior angles** equal to 90°.

Diagonal of a Rectangle

The length of the **diagonal (d)** is calculated using Pythagoras theorem: d = √(L² + B²).

Relation between Area and Perimeter

For a given perimeter, the **area is maximum** when the rectangle is a square (L = B).</p
